text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A bill on land rights passed its first reading in Mozambique's parliament on Thursday. The bill is in line with an article in the country's constitution making all land state property. The opposition Renamo party, which wants private land ownership, opposes the bill.
- New fuel prices came into force in Mozambique on Wednesday. The price of diesel is down 0.8 percent and paraffin drops 2.3 percent. The price of gasoline is unchanged.
